note: Every number the paper cites, with its source file. verified=false entries are relayed information without a machine record.  Source paths were rewritten at publication time: a path was replaced by its repository-relative location only when the local file was byte-identical (sha256) to a file in the published tree. Sources with no published counterpart are marked '(not in the release)'; see source_status on each fact. source_status is one of: 'published' (the file is in this repository), 'not-released' (it exists on the machine that produced it but is not published), 'not-a-file' (the source is a directory, or information relayed by e-mail rather than a machine record -- those also carry verified:false), and 'gone' (no file of that name exists any more). 'gone' means the file is unrecoverable, so it is only used after searching every known root; an earlier version of this index applied it to eight facts, all of which were in fact recoverable or were never files.
